review.headline: Tempo session completed as planned: 2 km easy, 5 km at threshold pace, 2 km easy, with the tempo block landing on target.
observations: Tempo block averaged 4:36/km against a 4:37/km target, held steady across all five 1 km splits at 276 s each.
Warm-up and cool-down ran at 5:45/km (HR 136 and 140), inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy range, so the controlled structure was respected.
Tempo HR averaged 163 with efficiency 1.304, a clear improvement on the 6 km tempo on 11-10 (HR 163 at 5:37/km, efficiency 1.093).
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so perceived effort is unknown for this session.
ATL (55.5) sits above CTL (47.2) with TSB at -4.3, so fatigue is building and should be watched.
Week 3 delivered 9.0 km of a 43.4 km plan and 1 of 7 sessions, so this quality session came after a heavily missed week.
